title: Clash - English manual

transcription.method: model-based visual reading of all rendered PDF pages and enlarged figure crops
transcription.status: main text complete; small or obscured screenshot text limitations marked inline

normalization: Preserve original wording, spelling, grammar, capitalization, and historical information where legible.
Join line-wrap hyphenation; represent layout and tables in Markdown.
Keep printed page boundaries and link each section to its scanned PDF page.
Label editorial observations and unreadable or obscured figure details as Transcription note.
editorial_notes: The cover also shows a United Kingdom flag and an illustrated armoured face.
These numbers label the main-map screenshot. Small in-game statistics in the screenshot are not reliably legible and are not reconstructed.
The building-information illustration shows, by legend number: 1 = 100; 2 = 5; 3 = 140; 4 = 0; 5 = 0; 6 = 100; 7 = 0; 8 = 1; 9 = 0. Its name is partly covered by the numbered callouts.

The unit-information illustration shows AP 36, morale 6, tiredness 0, attack-related values 18 and 5, and defence 5. The unit name and life-energy value are partly obscured by callouts and are not reconstructed.
The castle-yard screenshot visibly labels 1–7 and 9; the printed legend also lists 8 (school), but an 8 callout is not visible in this screenshot. Small toolbar values are not reliably legible.
The barracks screenshot labels the selected unit “builder” and shows 0 gold and a 100 value under an occupied unit slot. Some smaller statistics are obscured or unclear.

Readable text in the production screenshot includes “light infantry”, “Halberdman”, “Heavy cavalry”, “Troll”, and “3 turns until the end of production.” Small numeric interface values are not all reliably legible.

The court screenshot’s message reads: “The Queen is well and is willing to serve you, but she is not certain of her feelings towards you.” Player names in the small toolbar are not reliably transcribed.
The village screenshot includes “Tax”, population 132 with an upward arrow, satisfaction 88%, gold 200, tax 4.0, and zeros for income and the amounts to transfer. The destination name is unclear.
